predicates.label: Kind
predicates.description: quantity (a whole number in the tracker's unit), yesno or scale (1 to 5)

predicates.label: Unit
predicates.description: The whole unit a quantity tracker's values are stored in (minute, glass, ml...), as the owner chose it

predicates.label: Target
predicates.description: at_least, at_most or yes: what makes a day count as done

predicates.label: Target value
predicates.description: The threshold of at_least or at_most, in the tracker's unit

predicates.label: How often
predicates.description: day (every day), week (N done days per Monday-Sunday week) or days (at most N days between done days)

predicates.label: N
predicates.description: Done days per week, or most days between done days

predicates.label: State
predicates.description: active or retired (a retired tracker keeps its history)

predicates.label: Since
predicates.description: Day the tracker started, at noon local time

predicates.label: Until
predicates.description: Day the tracker was retired, at noon local time

predicates.label: Why
predicates.description: Why the owner tracks it, in their words

predicates.label: Order
predicates.description: Order in which the tracker was created, for the grid

predicates.label: Value
predicates.description: A day's value in the tracker's unit (tracker_unit); yes/no as 1/0; scale 1-5

predicates.label: Written later
predicates.description: Days between the recorded day and the day it was written; 0 = written on the day

predicates.label: Tracker
predicates.description: The tracker a record is about

predicates.label: Month
predicates.description: The month a reflection is about, YYYY-MM

predicates.label: Intention
predicates.description: The owner's intention for the next month, in their words
